title: Generalized Bayes for Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.03035v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification is central to many applications of causal machine learning, yet principled Bayesian inference for causal effects remains challenging. Standard Bayesian approaches typically require specifying a probabilistic model for the data-generating process, including high-dimensional nuisance components such as propensity scores and outcome regressions. Standard posteriors are thus vulnerable to strong modeling choices, including complex prior elicitation. In this paper, we propose a generalized Bayesian framework for causal inference. Our framework avoids explicit likelihood modeling; instead, we place priors directly on the causal estimands and update these using an identification-driven loss function, which yields generalized posteriors for causal effects. translated_title: 因果推断的广义贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 不确定性量化是因果机器学习许多应用的核心，然而对因果效应进行有原则的贝叶斯推断仍然充满挑战。标准贝叶斯方法通常需要为数据生成过程指定概率模型，其中包括倾向得分和结局回归等高维讨厌参数。因此，标准后验容易受到强建模选择（包括复杂的先验设定）的影响。在本文中，我们提出了一个用于因果推断的广义贝叶斯框架。我们的框架避免了显式的似然建模；相反，我们直接在因果估计目标（causal estimands）上放置先验，并使用由识别驱动的损失函数对其进行更新，从而得到因果效应的广义后验。由此，我们的框架将现有的基于损失的因果估计器转化为具有完整不确定性量化的估计器。我们的框架灵活且……
tldr: 提出了一种无需显式似然建模的广义贝叶斯因果推断框架，通过直接对因果估计目标设置先验并用识别驱动的损失函数进行更新，使现有基于损失的因果估计器具备完整的不确定性量化能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a generalized Bayesian framework for causal inference that avoids explicit likelihood modeling by placing priors directly on causal estimands and updating them via an identification-driven loss function, thereby turning existing loss-based causal estimators into ones with full uncertainty quantification.
